 - name: Plugins
 description: >-
 Agent Plugins imported into a project — read-only i

nventory and version
 detail.
 - name: Skills
 description: >-
 Cloud Skills: authored SKILL.md files stored in
a project. Read-only here.\n Environments pin skills by id (`skillSelection.skillIds`) and eval runs\n pin them with `--
compose-skill`, so this surface exists to give an\n unattended caller those ids; authoring is an app flow behind a beta gate.

- name: Sandbox images
 description: >-
 Custom Computer images: a digest-pinned Dockerfile built into an immutable\
n image your project's computers boot from.\n - name: Server diagnostics\n description: Connect-level health checks again

st a saved MCP server.
 - name: Primitives
 description: 'The server''s MCP primitives: tools, prompts, and resources.'
 -

name: Export
 description: Full-server snapshots for diffing and CI.
 - name: Execution
 description: 'Run the server''

s primitives: call tools, render prompts.'
 - name: Eval runs
 description: >-
 Asynchronous eval suite runs: create w

ith 202, poll status, iterations,
 and traces.
 - name: Conformance runs
 description: >-
 Ingest MCP spec-confo
rmance results from the SDK/CLI into project-owned\n history. Distinct from Eval runs (authored LLM cases) and from directory

readiness.
 - name: Server connections
 description: >-
 Connect an MCP server URL to a project, authorizing i

n a browser when the
 server requires it.
 - name: Server accounts
 description: >-
 The accounts a saved server
signs in with, addressed by id or by name.\n Tokens are write-only: an upload takes them and no route returns one.\n - name

: OAuth
 description: 'Bring-your-own OAuth: import externally obtained tokens for a server.'
 - name: Studies
 descript
ion: >-\n Publish a project environment as a **study** for people outside the\n project to talk to, read what they did,

and control who can reach it.
 Several of these NARROW access and take effect immediately.


 The pre-rename paths —
`/projects/{projectId}/scenarios`,\n `/projects/{projectId}/scenarios/{scenarioId}`,\n `/projects/{projectId}/environme
nts/{environmentId}/scenario` and\n `/projects/{projectId}/user-testing/scenarios/{scenarioId}/…` — keep\n working and a
re deliberately not documented here. They return their\n original bodies, which spell the owning id `scenarioId` and whose de
tail\n read carries no execution settings, and every response answers with\n `Deprecation: true` and a `Link` header nam

ing its successor. They are
 removed at general availability; a new integration should use the paths on
 this page.

- name: Catalog
 description: >-
 Discover the resources the other routes operate on: your account,
 projects, se

rvers, eval suites, and chat sessions.
 - name: Tunnels
 description: >-
 Relay tunnels that expose local MCP servers

through a public URL,
 registered as first-class project servers (the `mcpjam cloud tunnel` CLI
 flow).
 - name: Age

nt
 description: >-
 Headless agent turns over the public API: send a message history, the
 server runs one assist
ant turn with project-scoped workspace tools (eval\n reads + suite creation) on a pinned hosted model, and returns the reply\

n plus created-resource references.
 - name: Swarms
 description: >-
 Personas, journeys and swarm containers — t

he authoring half of Swarms —
 plus the model-backed generation that drafts them.
 - name: Swarm runs
 description: >-

Launching journeys and reading what they produced. Launching SPENDS — see
 the per-operation notes.
 - name: Swarm

insights
 description: >-
 What a swarm run revealed. The scorecard and findings are deterministic
 and free; req

uesting wave insights runs models and draws on your shared
 daily ledger.
 - name: Directory readiness
 description: >
-\n Grade a saved server against a publisher's listing requirements:\n Anthropic's connector directory or OpenAI's plugi
n directory. Reported as\n lane status and coverage, never as a numeric score, and excluded from\n `pooledConformanceSco
re`. Deterministic grading is free; model-backed\n experience observations are an explicit opt-in whose model cost is on\n

MCPJam — no credits are consumed — and they can never decide a verdict.
 - name: Registry
 description: >-
 Search
the scraped MCP directories (Claude, ChatGPT, and any future\n source), list curated/org registry cards, and install them int
o a project.\n Install writes a `servers` row and provenance — it does not open a live\n session. There is no catalog-un
install route: delete the project server\n instead. Directory reads require a bearer (including minted guest tokens)\n b

ut do not materialize a user. Card/connection reads and all writes are
 authed-non-guest.
 - name: Feedback
 descripti
on: >-\n Feedback about MCPJam itself (bugs, missing capabilities, confusing\n behavior), sent to the MCPJam team and ke

pt for 180 days. The
 `send_feedback` MCP tool calls the same endpoint.
paths:
 /projects/{projectId}/eval-suites:
 p

ost:
 tags:
 - Eval runs
 summary: Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)
 description: >-
Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases —\n and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOU
T executing anything. Use\n this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs`\n (passing the returned

`suiteId`).


 This is distinct from `POST /eval-runs`, which creates a run and
 **detaches execution**, respon

ding `202` with a `runId`. There is no
 concurrency cap here (no run is started).


 The body uses an ergonomic
authoring shape: a suite-level default\n `model` (and optional `provider`) applies to every test unless the test\n o
verrides it; `provider` is derived from a `provider/model` id when\n neither is supplied. Each test's case body is an order

ed `steps` array
 (prompt / toolCall / interact / assert).


 Guest callers are denied (suite creation is a writ

e).
